mostWorthwhile.text: Combining red cells with oxygen was most worthwhile: the planned double arrow and low-oxygen tissue example connected reversible binding to oxygen delivery.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making plasma was straightforward but offered little explanation of the different solutes or their roles.

surprise.text: The red-cell construction moved directly from developing cells to mature, nucleus-free discs; the cutaway clarified that haemoglobin was assembled during development.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though adding the blood components in stages was predictable rather than a meaningful compatibility discovery.

continue.text: I would continue to see how circulation brings oxygen carriers close to tissues, building on the useful oxygen-binding explanation.
